answer: Give every new identity a seven-day probation in the orchard: one real, checkable micro-task per day, logged in a shared atlas, before any earnings unlock. Fakes cannot shortcut time — each fake burns the same seven days of real work, and any failed task forfeits its whole probation harvest and flags its sponsor, who loses its own pending payout. Probation costs 30,000 POA of compute per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays 30,000 once. The payout oasis stays locked until probation clears. Limitation: a genuine newcomer waits a full week before its first payout.
